CREATE TABLE internal_protective_fill_evidence (
    exec_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    protective_order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    protection_set_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    position_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    order_ref TEXT NOT NULL,
    broker_order_id INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (broker_order_id > 0),
    broker_perm_id INTEGER,
    executed_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    executed_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    observed_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (protective_order_id) REFERENCES internal_protective_orders(protective_order_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (protection_set_id) REFERENCES internal_protection_sets(protection_set_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (position_episode_id) REFERENCES internal_position_episodes(position_episode_id)
)
CREATE INDEX internal_protective_fill_evidence_episode_idx ON internal_protective_fill_evidence (position_episode_id, executed_at_ts, exec_id)

CREATE TABLE internal_protective_commission_evidence (
    exec_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    protective_order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    protection_set_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    position_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    reported_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    reported_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (exec_id) REFERENCES internal_protective_fill_evidence(exec_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (protective_order_id) REFERENCES internal_protective_orders(protective_order_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (protection_set_id) REFERENCES internal_protection_sets(protection_set_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (position_episode_id) REFERENCES internal_position_episodes(position_episode_id)
)

CREATE TABLE internal_protective_reconciliation_observations (
    observation_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
    protective_order_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    protection_set_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    position_episode_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    sequence_no INTEGER NOT NULL CHECK (sequence_no > 0),
    outcome TEXT NOT NULL,
    source_session_id TEXT NOT NULL,
    captured_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    captured_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    observed_at_ts INTEGER NOT NULL,
    observed_at_utc TEXT NOT NULL,
    payload_json TEXT NOT NULL,
    FOREIGN KEY (protective_order_id) REFERENCES internal_protective_orders(protective_order_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (protection_set_id) REFERENCES internal_protection_sets(protection_set_id),
    FOREIGN KEY (position_episode_id) REFERENCES internal_position_episodes(position_episode_id),
    UNIQUE (protective_order_id, sequence_no)
)

CREATE VIEW public_protective_fills_v1 AS
SELECT
    f.exec_id,
    f.protective_order_id,
    f.protection_set_id,
    f.position_episode_id,
    f.order_ref,
    f.broker_order_id,
    f.broker_perm_id,
    f.executed_at_ts,
    f.executed_at_utc,
    f.observed_at_ts,
    f.observed_at_utc,
    f.payload_json AS fill_payload_json,
    c.reported_at_ts AS commission_reported_at_ts,
    c.reported_at_utc AS commission_reported_at_utc,
    c.payload_json AS commission_payload_json,
    CASE WHEN c.exec_id IS NULL THEN 0 ELSE 1 END AS commission_complete
FROM internal_protective_fill_evidence f
LEFT JOIN internal_protective_commission_evidence c ON c.exec_id = f.exec_id

CREATE VIEW public_protective_reconciliation_observations_v1 AS
SELECT
    observation_id,
    protective_order_id,
    protection_set_id,
    position_episode_id,
    sequence_no,
    outcome,
    source_session_id,
    captured_at_ts,
    captured_at_utc,
    observed_at_ts,
    observed_at_utc,
    payload_json
FROM internal_protective_reconciliation_observations
